about_the_game:
Twist-tac-toe is a fun, turn-based, game based on tic-tac-toe with extra twists which bring a new dimension to a classic game.

Twists and turns

Super tic-tac-toe: We heard you like tic-tac-toe, so we put tic-tac-toe inside a game of tic-tac-toe. But be careful, winning one of the smaller games of tic-tac-toe may allow your opponent to place their own winning piece!

Misère: You and your opponent play as X but you lose if you win.

Play bigger, play smaller: This is not your grandparent’s 3x3 tic-tac-toe. Play from 2x2 sizes upwards, in normal mode, super-tic-tac-toe mode, and more.

Head to head

Long or short? Play with game modes that support shorter casual games or longer strategic matches.

Challenge friends: Share a game with a friend and play via shared-screen, or online.

Play against community members: Match against other players to hone your skills.

Go solo with puzzles

Build your skills in solo mode: Solve a variety of puzzles for fun or to improve your technique. Or play competitive modes against computer opponents of varying skill.
